property_summary: After XBornID credits the owner and any subsequent distribution fires, the owner's balance must equal the accumulated totalDistributed (distributions accumulate into existing balances); the mutant overwrites balances[_to] with the last amount, so the owner's balance collapses to a single grant and no longer matches totalDistributed.
change_summary: Overwrite instead of accumulate: set balances[_to] = _amount rather than adding to the existing balance.
